final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g) AS above_avg FROM g WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM g)
